paragraphs.source_en: “Well, let us leave Latin aside for the moment and listen respectfully to Kangetsu’s story. It is just at the crucial point now. That violin has reached the hairbreadth crisis of whether it can stay hidden or not; it is just coming to the barrier of Ataka. Come now, Kangetsu, what happened after that?” So saying, Meitei suddenly showed the greatest eagerness and rejoined the violin faction. The master was heartlessly left behind. Kangetsu, encouraged all the more, went on to explain where he had hidden it.
